statement:
∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℂ),
  (∀ (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) →
    Continuous f' →
      f (2 * π) = f 0 →
        ∀ (n : ℤ),
          ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f' x * Complex.exp (-(↑n * ↑x * Complex.I)) =
            ↑n * Complex.I * ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x * Complex.exp (-(↑n * ↑x * Complex.I))
